Set the next state to nothing.
If the enemy is ready to act and not call helper, then set the next state to 12 and stop.
If the enemy is ready to act, then
  Let withoutAbilityList be the excluded moves of the enemy.
  Let ability be a weighted random move of the enemy other than withoutAbilityList.
  Let data be {}.
  If ability is 302033, then set data's 'activeTarget' to call helper2.
  The enemy uses ability with options data.
